ns2:course.label: Fictions of Equality
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in the Inequality & Cultural Understanding pathway. Introduces students to how fiction on the topic of Inequality shapes social and cultural understanding of the topic. Topics vary by section but each emphasizes experiential learning through, for example, projects, community engaged scholarship, field trips, archival work, or experimental writing.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Inequality, Humanities - Lit & Arts, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
